notes.title: Playtest edition live!
notes.notes: [p]Hello Everyone,[/p][p]I've brought back the playtest edition of Peacequarium. Several people were really wanting it back so I  brought it back with the same content as the demo version (it is currently identical to the demo version of the game, apart from Steam items and achievements), and I think some players had not completed all the playtest edition achievements or made use of their gift boxes. [/p][p]Please do not run the demo and playtest at the same time otherwise each will be overwriting the same save file![/p][p]Over the coming months I plan to update both the demo and playtest editions of Peacequarium with some new fun and relaxing content.[/p][p]Thanks,[/p][p]GTGD[/p]

notes.title: Small patch - gold fever multiplier limited to 125x
notes.notes: Hello! Just a really small update to put a cap on the gold fever multiplier. It is now capped at 1000 increments (1000 purchases) and for players who went to Centillions this will also help reset their gold fever multiplier to a sane number and keep it sane!

notes.title: Reset Option for Income Multiplier and Money
notes.notes:
Hello! If you made it to 1e303 Centillion and beyond then you've almost reached the end of numbers on a computer! So I've added a reset button in the Settings menu for resetting the income multiplier and money. This way you don't have to reset your save file and you can continue to enjoy your aquariums.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138625/e5eaf58f62c0640f4dcaf7f4528ce8f3c8ffa186.png[/img]

notes.title: Quests!
notes.notes:
Hello! Selling fish doesn't earn you much as you progress into the game so with this update I'm sort of addressing that. Now you can research and buy the Quest menu and it will be a single quest showing what fully grown up fish you need to sell to complete the quest. Upon completing the requirements the quest will be automatically completed and you'll be awarded with a Jade treasure chest that is equal to the cost of the green Income multiplier upgrade!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138625/c653352cc0cabbe6363aa7be82a898242ff0635f.png[/img]

notes.title: Large numbers should behave correctly now!
notes.notes: Hello! The game was broken when getting to larger numbers 1e33 approximately. I've edited the code and now the game should properly support numbers up to 1e303 (Centillion)! Thanks to everyone reporting bugs and issues they've been encountering with the game!

notes.title: Custom water and light colour
notes.notes:
Hello! I've added a new colour scheme called Custom Colours 1 and once you've researched and bought it, you'll be able to change the water body, water crest, and primary light colours to any colour in the colour wheel. If you click or drag outside the colour wheel then black will be the colour returned!

You will need a quintillion dollars to buy it though and perhaps one of the faster ways to get that much money is to keep upgrading the green income multiplier, increasing worms to summon the treasure chest and gold fever fish, and not deplete worms too much so as to ensure a fast worm recharge rate, and upgrading species levels!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138625/2c203dbcdb9d26ba20fbc774ed9244245df53cb6.png[/img]

notes.title: Shop Filter and Upgrading Natural Growth
notes.notes:
Hello All,
I hope you're able to read these patch notes, I have no idea if they are publicly visible to players of the play test!

You can now filter the shop menu so it is less cluttered. From the right side of the shop menu you can select a filter and then that will narrow down what you have to look at in the shop. The categories are; Show All, Fish Packs, Multiplier Upgrades, Aquarium Upgrades, Backgrounds, Colour Schemes.

I've added a new upgrade which is Natural Growth. Your baby fish gain 1 EXP every 5 seconds without you having to do anything and I've now added a upgrade option for this in the shop menu and you can upgrade this endlessly. You don't have the auto feeder submarine in this beta so this is a pretty good way to have your fish grow faster passively when you just need the game to idle in the background while you work on other things.

I've fixed a bunch of bugs, so thanks to everyone reporting them.

Btw, Olexa played the playtest of Peacequarium! Please tell your favourite streamers/influencers to play Peacequarium!
[previewyoutube=74Xdc-8C_3M;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Give thy fish a name!
notes.notes:
[h1]Big numbers and full screen[/h1]
The numbers in Peacequarium can now go up to Vigintillions 1e63 and the earnings per second scales up as per the cost of the green Income Multiplier upgrade. This ensures that your earnings per second keeps pace with the big numbers so it doesn't feel that getting to the next level of big numbers is out of reach!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131850/1606faa21982c6ec764ec73f8a47f86309badc81.jpg[/img]

You can now play the game in full screen windowed mode! Open your settings menu and press the toggle screen size button. On Windows you can dock the game around the screen like any other window!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131850/19a7442a930c780b31df0312fe4186b67af6d068.jpg[/img]

[h1]Naming your fish[/h1]
You can name your fish from the fish/sell menu. Just click on the fish name such as Koi and start typing and the default species name will be replaced with your name for the fish.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131850/26cbbf6732ac6ad866bca7992d534ff03d4815aa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131850/6cfd27e6fe382fde09b7094a91309dbbee7bf0d7.png[/img]

[h1]Fish traits and glowing fish[/h1]
I've added fish traits which give the fish some uniqueness. Fish traits are Steam inventory items (I've changed them to not tradable or marketable) that are dropped regularly and you can apply these to your fish from the fish/sell menu. Once applied the trait will remain permanently on that fish. In the full game there is a gatherer trait and a fish with it will collect any wholesome buff it comes across!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131850/5eac3782c5154eb15434d737703f9b14b0b3eb6f.jpg[/img]

The fish that get added to your steam inventory are glowing ones. They are visually different and have three times the earnings per second and value of a normal fish. You spawn these fish into your tank from the gift menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131850/f1f0dc29d22202c4ad55893d0295e7149f7e6e55.png[/img]

[h1]New Species Levels[/h1]
I've redone fish species levels from scratch and I think the numbers make more sense now. You can upgrade the level of each fish species infinitely and this makes a big impact on your earnings per second and the value of the fish for selling purpose. This can be accessed from the Creature Collection menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131850/e99636e1f9dfc4e074be6020e217ce5e605ab956.png[/img]

Btw, have you subscribed to my [url=subscribepage.io/Oeri26]newsletter[/url]? 

Thanks,
GTGD

notes.title: Peacequarium + Your Feedback = AWESOME!
notes.notes:
Hey, thanks for playing the playtest. In the last month I've made some mega improvements to Peacequarium to make it more fun and engaging and I've been taking your feedback very seriously. I believe I've incorporated all feedback that contributes to making Peacequarium a better experience and I've successfully integrated Twitch, Steam Achievements, and Steam inventory into the upcoming full game and this playtest!

The most exciting feature I've added are fish traits which add more character to whichever fish you apply them to and makes them more useful. Traits don't persist on closing down the game which creates a nice sink for the trait item economy. I've successfully got a gatherer trait working in the full game and any fish with that trait will collect any wholesome buff it touches automatically (and be wearing a red cap :D ). The playtest has four of the traits available and these are supplied as Steam items over time in your Steam inventory which you can consume in game. Pro tip, if you want to achieve the Fish Collector achievements, then apply a breeder trait to a fish you don't have enough of. Make sure there is enough space in the same aquarium and then leave it to spawn new fish of its species every half hour! Check your Creature Collection menu to know how many of each species you have in stock.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138625/5eac3782c5154eb15434d737703f9b14b0b3eb6f.jpg[/img]

You can apply a trait by going to your fish menu and then clicking on the blue trait icon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138625/80958cf2ce6b6728e51cea9fabd647e8fa4ea273.jpg[/img]

I've made lots of quality of life improvements but a real notable one is that the game now remembers when you press a lock or unlock button for each rarity of fish. When you buy fish you no longer have to keep pressing the lock buttons for each rarity. The game will remember if you pressed the lock button for epic for example and if you spawn any epic fish they will automatically be locked. This applies when starting up the game as well, it will remember which species you want locked or unlocked on spawn. I still have to figure out a way to properly show you what the remembered selection is, so that is a work in progress.

The fast buy buttons are pretty cool and I've managed to speed up the code behind fast purchasing fish and populating the fish menu so it is a fluid operation now. This enables mass buying fish, mass selling and using the fast buy buttons to try and increase your number of epic and rare fish if that is your strategy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138625/030b00c52f0f519ed48e39f75ba942f3fd457495.jpg[/img]

In the Creature Collection menu you only need to hold down your left click now and species levels will automatically keep being bought until you release left click. This is quite a powerful way to increase your earnings per second.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138625/910fc2cd6a18e8dcfb441ac95ca1b44515770b4f.jpg[/img]

The glowing fish that get added to your Steam inventory have a visual difference, but they also have double EPS and value of their regular counterparts, so they are very much worth keeping and putting into your aquariums if you want to maximise your EPS!

I'm currently continuing to work on the full game content and I'm also aiming to launch the demo for Peacequarium in early November. At this time I'm thinking I will end the playtest when I launch the demo (the demo will replace the playtest) and this will save me from having to maintain an additional project in addition to the full game and demo. Your save progress and Steam achievements will go across to the demo but your Steam items will not, so I recommend that you freely use your items! 

There's a ten percent chance on opening a gift box that you'll receive the platinum treasure chest! It gives a mega wealth reward :D

If you have a moment please tell a friend about Peacequarium, and thanks to those of you who did already! Word of mouth I believe is the number one way to help a game reach more people and let them experience it as well.

Thanks and keep the helpful feedback coming,
GTGD
